name: Callback out-of-gas in {{withdraw}}
description: Call `{{withdraw}}` with 8-300 Tgas; at every budget, funds paid + funds still withdrawable must equal the deposit.

checks.message: With {tgas} Tgas attached to `{{withdraw}}`, the callback ran short of gas and left the books half-applied: withdrawing everything afterwards got the user {net.user} instead of +5.0000 NEAR.

explain.held: At every caller gas from 8 to 300 Tgas the user could recover exactly 5.0000 NEAR. No half-applied state. Sweep: {sweep}
